title.narrative: REPSSI - Achieving better SRHR outcomes (2024-2026) - Endline evaluation REPSSI - Achieving better SRHR outcomes (2024-2026)

description.narrative: Förbättrad tillgång till SRHR-information och tjänster för utsatta och marginaliserade pojkar, flickor och ungdomar i östra och södra Afrika för bättre SRHR-resultat.
Improved access to SRHR information and services for vulnerable and marginalized boys, girls and youth in East and Southern Africa for better SRHR outcomes.

The overall goal is that adolescents enjoy good mental health, and can access information and services that enhance their sexual and reproductive health and rights. This will be reached through the following three objectives:
1. Strengthen capacity of community support structures, in the identification, management and referral of adolescents in need of psychosocial support and SRHR services.
2. Enhance the capacity of the health service workforce at selected health facilities, to integrate mental health and psychosocial support into SRHR services for adolescents.
3. Advocate for the integration of MHPSS and SRHR in relevant regional and national policy and legal frameworks to enhance their responsiveness to the MHPSS and SRHR needs of adolescents.

tag.narrative: 3.3 - By 2030, end the epidemics of AIDS, tuberculosis, malaria and neglected tropical diseases and combat hepatitis, water-borne diseases and other communicable diseases.
3.3 - Senast 2030 utrota epidemierna av aids, tuberkulos, malaria och försummade tropiska sjukdomar samt bekämpa hepatit, vattenburna sjukdomar och andra smittsamma sjukdomar.
3.4 - By 2030, reduce by one third premature mortality from non-communicable diseases through prevention and treatment and promote mental health and well-being.
3.4 - Till 2030 genom förebyggande insatser och behandling minska det antal människor som dör i förtid av icke smittsamma sjukdomar med en tredjedel samt främja psykisk hälsa och välbefinnande.

3.7 - By 2030, ensure universal access to sexual and reproductive health-care services, including for family planning, information and education, and the integration of reproductive health into national strategies and programmes.

3.7 - Senast 2030 säkerställa att alla har tillgång till sexuell och reproduktiv hälsovård, inklusive familjeplanering, information och utbildning, och att reproduktiv hälsa integreras i nationella strategier och program.
